fields.action: "(i) where the Corporation will hold accounts for the purpose of delivering" cash and Eligible Securities to and "receiving" cash and Eligible Securities from "Participants to settle Cash Treasury Transactions and Clear to Deliver Transactions" and "(ii) where the Corporation and Participants may hold accounts for the purpose of delivering cash and Eligible Securities to and receiving cash and Eligible Securities from one another to settle Clear to Hold Transactions and to hold Eligible Securities as collateral for such transactions." These changes maintain distinct settlement processes for Cash Treasury Transactions and Clear to Deliver Transactions on the one hand and Clear to Hold Transactions on the other hand, while clarifying that for purposes of settling Cash Treasury Transactions and Clear to Deliver Transactions, the Securities Settlement Bank designated by CMESC will hold CMESC's accounts and Participants are not required to maintain settlement accounts at the same designated Securities Settlement Bank, while for purposes of settling Clear to Hold Transactions, the Securities Settlement Bank designated by CMESC will hold both CMESC's and Participants' accounts; and
